en: A single movable pulley halves the effort force needed to lift a load, meaning a 100-newton weight requires only 50 newtons of pull.
Ice has a friction coefficient around 0.03, making it roughly ten times slipperier than dry asphalt, which has a coefficient near 0.7.
The Moon's gravity is one-sixth of Earth's, so a person weighing 120 pounds on Earth would weigh only 20 pounds on the Moon.
An electromagnet in a scrap yard can lift 1,000 kilograms of steel, but it instantly drops the heavy load when the electrical current is turned off.
A standard AA battery provides 1.5 volts of electricity, while a typical Philippine household wall outlet supplies a much stronger 220 volts.
Light travels at 300,000 kilometers per second in air, which is about 870,000 times faster than sound travels at 343 meters per second.
Sound travels through water at 1,480 meters per second, which is over four times faster than its speed of 343 meters per second in air.
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius in Manila, but it boils at only 90 degrees Celsius in Baguio City due to the lower air pressure.
The human brain uses about 20 percent of the body's total energy, consuming roughly 300 kilocalories daily just to process thoughts and signals.
A wood screw with ten threads per centimeter advances exactly one millimeter forward into the wood for every single full turn.
One kilocalorie of heat energy is the exact amount required to raise the temperature of one kilogram of liquid water by one degree Celsius.
Sunlight travels 150 million kilometers to reach Earth in exactly eight minutes and twenty seconds, moving at 300,000 kilometers per second.
